archive: git clone https://github.com/fluffos/nightmare3 (not a traditional archive file — a maintained, already FluffOS-adapted fork; mudlib root is the repo's lib/ directory)
name: Nightmare 3
english_description: One of the oldest and most historically influential LPMud mudlib families, an ancestor of the TMI-2 lineage. This fork (fluffos/nightmare3) is already updated for modern FluffOS. New characters pick a race in a genesis void room before rolling stats and entering Praxis, the mudlib's own shipped example domain — a full town with shops, a bank, a graveyard, mountain caves, and an orc valley — built around a central Monument Square, with five playable classes (fighter, cleric, mage, rogue, kataan) and three joinable guilds (druids, philosophers, witches). Unlike the rest of this collection, content is in English, included deliberately for its historical importance to the wider LPMud family tree. Onboarding found and fixed a filename-parsing bug that had silently broken virtually every player command, and a follow-up deep-test pass fixed three more real bugs (a broken starting-stat sequence leaving every new character at -1 stamina, a completely silent shopkeeper dialogue system, and a missing save directory that made all six class halls unreachable) — several of which have since been contributed upstream as PRs against fluffos/nightmare3.
